problems: No merger is described. The filings propose that The Gabelli Dividend & Income Trust contribute about $100 million of its assets to the newly organized The Gabelli Global Small and Mid Cap Value Trust and distribute Global Trust common shares as a dividend to its shareholders; this is an asset contribution and share distribution, not a merger of the funds. The 2014 425 letters ask for votes on it; no excerpt states the outcome. The 2015 DEF 14A is an annual meeting proxy to elect trustees.
